scope: PR65 bounded EDFE airport-play native and Chrome integration observations; no selected C172S fidelity, surveyed runway or installed-lighting acceptance.

capture.procedure: Preserve the existing JSON stdout from the completed commands without rerunning them. Verify current source files against the recorded revision and verify the still-present local WASM SHA-256 against its build-info metadata.

environment_observed_at_capture.limitation: Node/OS/architecture values were read when this observation record was captured, not independently attested by the original command stdout.

build_info.emcc: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.13 (e13ee988ce3d87a738dd8f3661d02223308c412a)

adaptations: Direct-drive design RPM replaces Aero-Matic tip-speed/gearbox heuristic
Retain pinned propeller geometry, inertia and Mach corrections; replace only fixed-pitch CP/CT tables
No tuning to a C172 glide ratio or aircraft-specific reference curve
propeller_adapter.scope: generic research fixed-pitch windmilling; not accepted aircraft data

checks: EDFE26 and08 start stationary with all gear supported; full parking hold does not collide
COM8.33 selection loads standby, explicit swap changes active
Options select vector terrain/map and practice lights
release brake and power produces actual native ground acceleration
map Stop preserves Review and locks start/COM during Review

limitations: This record preserves observed stdout; it does not rerun the commands or independently validate their assertions.
Browser map and imagery pixels use local fixtures. Native worker, public DEM packages, bundled vector data and COM records are exercised by the test.
Native takeoffs use a scripted pilot over public terrain; timings are integration observations, not calibrated C172 performance.

The generic c172x research aircraft/model and generated WASM/runtime closure are deliberately not redistributed in the repository. Build metadata and hashes identify the observed binary without preserving its complete executable/model closure.
Runway geometry is approximate and prepared only for EDFE. Practice PAPI/lighting is illustrative; installed-equipment layout and obstacle clearance remain unverified.
No independent acceptance or cross-provider peer review is conferred by this observation record.
